_comment: EXAMPLE. Copy to model_routes.json and edit — the real file is gitignored.
A MODEL is an ordered list of ENDPOINTS. Clients ask for the model NAME
('flash'); Robin picks which endpoint serves this conversation.
Plain list  -> ordered failover only: bind the first, move down on error.
Dict form   -> {rotate: [...], fallback: [...]}. Each NEW conversation
starts one position further around the rotate pool, so every
plan's 5h/weekly window gets used; the conversation itself
stays put (prefix caches are per-provider and agent clients
replay the whole transcript every turn).
fallback is pay-as-you-go: tried only when the whole pool
failed or is parked, and NEVER rotated into the head.
Providers named here must exist in llm_providers.json.
